Bpw.notes: Two-stage fight, not a melee walker. STAGE A: Jalhalla floats as an intangible giant Poe and NOTHING but light touches it (d_a_bpw.cpp:428-447). Link must aim the Mirror Shield's reflected beam (AT_TYPE_LIGHT) at it: the opacity byte m47E climbs 200 -> 255 at +1 per frame of contact (~55 frames of held beam) and then it solidifies and drops. A Light Arrow (AT_TYPE_LIGHT_ARROW) solidifies it in one hit. STAGE B: while solid it is a carryable actor (attention distances[CARRY]=0x25) for 450 frames; Link lifts it (JITA1) and throws it (TAMA1). The throw only hurts it if wall_HIT_check returns 2, i.e. it lands on one of the arena's spiked pillars - a plain wall/floor bounce does nothing. A damaging throw bursts it into `health` Poes (PW actor, its own entry below); Jalhalla's health IS the live Poe count, so killing the Poes is what drains it. The phase ends when health falls to 10 / 5 / 0 (m3F6 0/1/2) or after 420 frames, and the survivors regather. At health 0 the death demo runs, dComIfGs_onStageBossEnemy() sets the per-stage boss-dead field and a warp flower spawns (2889/2910). Attacks: fire breath (SUIKOMU1 inhale -> HONOO1, spawns Bpw damage-ball children, AT_TYPE_FIRE Atp 6 for the stream / 4 for a loose ball) when Link is beyond 1050 units, body press (TAME1 -> PRESS1, or SONOBA_PRESS in place) when closer, plus a curse charge (MOVEB1 -> MOVES1 at speedF 75) that possesses Link and inverts his controls via the TORITUKI1 sub-actor. The body At sphere is Atp 0 - bumping into him only shoves. One actor class serves four roles by mType: 0 BODY, 1 KANTERA (the lantern), 2 DAMAGE_BALL (fire), 3 TORITUKI (possession); the numbers here are the BODY role. Four functions carry /* Nonmatching */ but all are annotated as cosmetic (regalloc / inline ordering) with complete bodies, so the constants are trustworthy: kankyou_hendou (602), action_bunri_dousa (2064), daBPW_Execute (4043), boss_useHeapInit (4244). Boss stage is M_DaiB. radius/height are the acch wall cylinder; the body damage sphere is r240-260 and the attack sphere r220 (500 mid-press). hover is the m3AC.y model lift above the ground (300 while carried, 140 as the escaping mask). flinch_frames is the BOYON bounce-off length, not a stun - non-light hits never stagger him.

Bwd.notes: REAL ACTOR NAME IS `Bwd` - the mined story-data guess `Bmgn` is WRONG and nothing by that name exists in the decomp. Its larva is `Bwds` (d_a_bwds.cpp, own entry below). Neither d_a_bwd.cpp nor d_a_bwds.cpp contains a single /* Nonmatching */ stub, so these numbers are fully trustworthy. THE FIGHT: Molgera swims through the sand floor of a round arena (radius ~3000 around the origin, floor Y = l_HIO.m28 - 400) and surfaces to bite. Its body spheres are lethal contact (Atp 8) but cannot be damaged; the only target is the tongue sphere (r70) hanging out of its mouth, and that sphere accepts AT_TYPE_HOOKSHOT and nothing else while it is burrowing. Hookshotting the tongue yanks Molgera out of the sand (BWD_NUKARERU -> _LOOP) and opens a 120-frame window in which any weapon connects; every hit deals exactly 1 damage regardless of weapon (the code forces health to 0x14, runs cc_at_check, then subtracts 1 by hand). Three hits in one window complete a stagger; on the stagger it thrashes (BWD_DAMAGE2) and spits out up to 3 Molgera Larvae, capped at 5 alive. After 2 staggers it leaves the sand entirely and dive-bombs from the air (state 10 'fly' at speedF 40, state 11 's_fly' at 65, BWD_JATTACK1/2/3); after 4 staggers it dies. hp 12 = 4 staggers x 3 hits. Its bite (BWD_ATTACK, 29 f, mouth open from frame 27) swallows Link if a body sphere connects or he is within 150 units, and he is spat back out by setThrowDamage. Surfacing sends a shockwave that shoves Link with setOutPower 6.0 falling off over 4000 units - that is the `knockback` value, it is a push not a damage number. FIELDS LEFT NULL: height (it is a worm built from 17 spheres along a spline, there is no capsule); gravity/terminal (all vertical motion is scripted cLib_addCalc2 toward target heights, speed.y is never integrated); walk (while burrowing it is moved by the same scripted interpolation, not speedF); hover (the swim depth is an absolute arena Y, not an offset); notice (it is a boss, always aware - the attention distances[BATTLE]=0x22 is a lookup index, not a world distance). `lose` = 3000 is the distance at which it dives and repositions next to Link, not a disengage. Death sets dComIfGs_onStageBossEnemy() and spawns a warp flower (1768-1772). Boss stage is kazeB.

Bwds.notes: Molgera's sub-actor, a separate actor class with its own stats. Fully matched (no /* Nonmatching */ anywhere in d_a_bwds.cpp). It swims under the sand at speedF 7 toward Link, leaps out with a 2.7/frame gravity arc and bites for Atp 2, then dives back in. Only its head sphere (r32, r48-64 with the mouth open) takes damage, and only after it has surfaced (m02FB==1); 4 HP kills it. It carries a second, hookshot-only sphere of radius 240 so Link can pluck it out of the air with the Hookshot - that is the intended way to clear them, and it is also how Link is pulled toward Molgera. FIELDS LEFT NULL: height (it is a 15-sphere segmented worm, no capsule), turn_s16 (the turn rate is a ramping cLib_addCalcAngleS2 velocity starting from m030C = 3000, not a fixed per-frame step), notice/lose/attack_range/hit_frame/flinch_frames (it has no sight or engagement logic at all - it is spawned already targeting Link and simply chases until it dies or its m014 = 220 frame life timer runs out; l_HIO.m018 = 2000 is only a distance clamp on the chase target). The clip map is honest but thin: the archive genuinely only contains koboss_pakupaku and koboss_close, so every locomotion state reuses the chomp loop and both the hurt and death states use the mouth-close.
